description: Defines structures, macros, and function prototypes related to pathspec handling in a version control system, including pathspec parsing, matching, and attributes.

classes.name: struct pathspec
classes.description: Represents a set of path specifications with associated attributes and options.

classes.name: struct pathspec_item
classes.description: Represents an individual path pattern within a pathspec.

classes.name: struct attr_match
classes.description: Defines attribute matching modes for pathspec items.

classes.name: struct attr_check
classes.description: Referenced in pathspec items for attribute checking (details not provided).

methods.name: parse_pathspec
methods.description: Converts command line arguments into a pathspec set, supporting various magic features.

methods.name: parse_pathspec_file
methods.description: Parses pathspecs from a file or stdin.

methods.name: pathspec_magic_names
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string of pathspec magic flags.

methods.name: add_pathspec_matches_against_index
methods.description: Adds matches of a pathspec against an index to a 'seen' array.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_against_index
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches against an index.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_skip_worktree
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches that skip worktree entries.

methods.name: match_pathspec_attrs
methods.description: Matches pathspec attributes against index entries.

methods.name: match_pathspec
methods.description: Checks if a path matches a given pathspec.

methods.name: match_leading_pathspec
methods.description: Matches leading pathspecs, setting directory match flags.

methods.name: pathspec_needs_expanded_index
methods.description: Determines if index expansion is needed for a pathspec.
